pet_notes: Create a compact whole-body Codex pet inspired by the user: production-grade Zynx workflow builder, pragmatic implementation energy, careful source-of-truth thinking, Thai/Zynx product fluency, real automation over mockups. Visual idea: a small luminous workflow-forge companion with a calm focused face, matte graphite and warm teal body, tiny node-link chest markings, and a small blueprint/tool charm integrated into its silhouette. No readable text, no logos, no UI screenshots, no floating symbols. It should feel capable, calm, fast to act, and honest about verification.
style_notes: Polished compact 3D toy mascot, readable at 192x208, graphite/teal with small amber accents, clean silhouette, friendly but not childish, no shadows or scenery.
style_contract: Pet-safe sprite: compact full-body mascot, readable in a 192x208 cell, clear silhouette, simple face, stable palette/materials, and crisp edges for chroma-key extraction. Style `3d-toy`: Stylized 3D toy mascot with smooth rounded forms, simple materials, clear silhouette, and no photoreal complexity.
